title.en: The Dying Gasps of the Shroud

texts.zh: 随着位于[From.GetName]的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。
texts.en: With the [From.GetName] having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to escape.

texts.zh: 随着以太相引擎即将完工，我们操纵虚境的能力极大地提升了。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要阻挠我们的计划。
texts.en: As the Aetherophasic Engine nears completion, our ability to manipulate the Shroud is rapidly increasing. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to thwart our efforts.

label.en: We are running out of time...

label.zh: 他们在这里可找不到安宁。
label.en: They will find no solace here.
